bull_bear_summary.bull_case: Fortress balance sheet (zero long-term debt, massive liquidity). Critical infrastructure enabler for AI and cloud data centers — supplies high-performance switches/software to hyperscalers (Meta, Microsoft). Revenue grew from $4.9B (2022) to $7.0B (2024), net income more than doubled over same period. Expanding TAM via AI networking ($2.75-3.25B target for 2026), campus networking ($1.25B target), and VeloCloud SD-WAN acquisition. Consistent earnings beats (4 consecutive quarters, avg +9.8% surprise). Zacks Rank #1 stock. 20%+ revenue growth trajectory into 2026-2027.
bull_bear_summary.bear_case: Heavy customer concentration risk — few hyperscale cloud customers drive majority of revenue; loss of one key account would cause sharp sales drop. Premium valuation multiple leaves little room for execution slips. Microsoft contract cancellations signal potential vendor diversification risk. Margin pressure expected: management guiding GM 62-63% (compression from prior levels), Wolfe Research flagging margin headwinds. Growth rate decelerating (27% in 2025 -> 20% target in 2026). Competition from Cisco in campus, potential InfiniBand vs Ethernet debate in AI networking. Tariff and macro risks to enterprise spending.
